title: Key (Editor's Office)
summary: Opens the iron grate at X 66, Y −61 leading to the Baldur’s Mouth elevator.

fields.Acquisition: On the table in Ettvard Needle’s private office. A DC 15 Sleight of Hand check also opens the grate.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
